selection: One fixed-size recipe per signal: discovery >=40 trades and >=6 active days, complete account; rank validation net among discovery-eligible recipes with >=20 validation trades, >=3 active days and complete account. No positive threshold needed to retain a negative diagnostic result. Later splits never select recipe.
economic_admission: NOT_ESTABLISHED: previously inspected diagnostic week, only five test days and two extension days; new untouched periods required.
limitations: Historical BBO taker quote assumption, no depth/queue/market impact guarantee
Fixed UTC intraday window, no overnight or session-boundary claims
Commission is assumed, not measured broker cost
Separate fresh account per split; unresolved filled position terminates that split
Capped martingale and anti-martingale are post-selection risk comparisons, never entry-edge selection
